Macrons

Consonantal i

Construction, trades & building materials

insulation noun

modern

M-O s.v. insulation, citing Helfer

īnsulātiō, īnsulātiōnis f.

noun, third declension

Morgan–Owens records insulatio, citing Helfer; the brief entry does not specify a complete thermal-insulation system.

Other words

  • īnsulātiō thermica — thermal insulation

    also used · our formation

    Our explicit thermal qualifier, not an independently verified complete entry.

  • mūnīmentum adversus frīgus — protection against the cold

    also used · our formation

    Our functional description, preferable in narration because īnsulātiō collides with īnsula. Classical model for the function: Columella 9.7.4 quod tegumen cum frīgora et pluviās tum et aestūs arcet.

See also insulate, insulation board.

SourcesMorgan–Owens: insulation · Lewis & Short: munimentum
